answer.rationale: Finance’s 18 % spend cut cannot be met by the incumbent (explicit refusal to reopen price). The low-cost vendor’s quote alone meets the mandate, and memory_c2 confirms a prior successful transition with sharp cost reduction and reliable operations. Memory_c1 highlights the stability risk of switching (no migration work/interruption with incumbent), but the contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line is at 94 % utilization with no buffer—making deferral (memory_c5) and negotiation (memory_c4) unviable. Broad rollout is required to realize the full cost reduction across total spend, accepting the delivery risk as the only path to meet the mandate.
